body: The Titramax 101 Vibrating Shaker holds four multi-well plates on a 220 x 220 mm platform, with a 3 mm orbit and continuously variable speed from 150 to 1,350 rpm.

body: The Titramax 100 Vibrating Shaker is a laboratory shaker with a 1.5 mm circular vibrating orbit, continuously variable speeds from 150 to 1,350 rpm, a 220 x 220 mm platform, and both timed and continuous operating modes for gentle biological sample mixing.

Gentle mixing is often the difference between maintaining healthy cultures and damaging sensitive samples. Cell cultures, microorganisms and suspension samples need continuous movement to prevent settling, distribute nutrients evenly and improve oxygen transfer, but excessive agitation can expose them to unnecessary shear stress.
The compact 1.5 mm orbit produces smooth circular motion rather than vigorous agitation, making it suitable for workflows where sample integrity is more important than maximum mixing force.
Continuous circular movement keeps cells and suspended particles evenly distributed, reducing sedimentation during incubation and long-duration experiments.
The analogue speed control allows shaking intensity to be matched to vessel size, media viscosity and biological protocol instead of relying on fixed settings.
The 220 x 220 mm platform accommodates multiple culture vessels so every sample experiences identical shaking conditions throughout the experiment.
The integrated timer operates for up to 120 minutes, while continuous mode supports incubation protocols and long-running biological experiments.
Operating below 50 dB(A), the Titramax 100 is suitable for shared laboratory environments where equipment may run throughout the day.

The Heidolph Vibramax 100 is designed for laboratory workflows where vigorous circular vibration delivers better sample suspension than gentle orbital motion. Its 3 mm orbit combined with speeds from 150 to 2,500 rpm creates rapid, uniform agitation for suspending solids, dissolving compounds and performing leaching studies. Together with the non-slip rubber mat, samples remain stable even during high-speed operation. The integrated 120-minute timer supports repeatable protocols, while continuous operation handles longer experiments. With a compact footprint, quiet operation and reliable performance, the Vibramax 100 fits naturally into research, analytical, environmental, pharmaceutical and academic laboratories.

longForm.heroLead: The full-power orbital drive, without the automation layer you may not need. The Hei-SHAKE Orbital Core delivers the core functions a laboratory needs for any shaking application, from a 1 to 530 rpm speed range to a 20 mm orbit that ensures homogeneous distribution across every vessel on the platform. Applications run in continuous operation or against a timer set from 1 minute to 999 hours 59 minutes, with an RS232 interface that connects the shaker to a PC or to server-based software such as Hei-PROCESS for semi-automated control. Automatic restart after a power failure is set through a straightforward menu structure, so unattended runs recover without manual intervention. The 294 x 263 mm platform, rated to 15 kg, accommodates a wide range of flasks, bottles and vessels for demanding batch work. Supplied with the Flat Rubber Mat 1000, the Orbital Core is ready for daily laboratory use from installation.
